name: What should I consider when choosing a general contractor for my home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a general contractor for my home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a general contractor, prioritize experience, clear communication, and a strong portfolio of similar projects. Verify their licensing and insurance to ensure they are properly credentialed and that your project is protected. Ask for references from past clients and review their testimonials. A reliable contractor will offer a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, timeline, and cost. It's also important to feel comfortable with their team and their approach to project management, as you will be working closely with them.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, clear communication, and a strong portfolio. Verify licenses and insurance, check references, and ensure a detailed proposal is provided.
